item.title: Gharibabadi: Europe was part of infrastructure of US aggression against Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi has said NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte’s admission that some 5,000 sorties were flown from European bases in support of US military aggression against Iran proves that Europe formed part of the infrastructure of that aggression.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86273860/Gharibabadi-Europe-was-part-of-infrastructure-of-US-aggression

Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi has said NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte’s admission that some 5,000 sorties were flown from European bases in support of US military aggression against Iran proves that Europe formed part of the infrastructure of that aggression.

item.title: Araghchi: Europe must confront US aggression
item.description: New York, IRNA — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi continued an intensive diplomatic activity on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly, holding talks with his counterpart from Spain, and placing Washington’s war of aggression, the insecurity it has manufactured in West Asia, and the Zionist regime’s ongoing occupation and genocide at the center of his discussions.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86273795/Araghchi-Europe-must-confront-US-aggression

New York, IRNA — Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi continued an intensive diplomatic activity on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly, holding talks with his counterpart from Spain, and placing Washington’s war of aggression, the insecurity it has manufactured in West Asia, and the Zionist regime’s ongoing occupation and genocide at the center of his discussions.

item.title: ‘We are not afraid of war’ is unwavering voice of Iranian nation, says IRGC top commander
